Creator.description: Object describing the creator of the shared element.

SyntheticsAssertion.description:
Object describing the assertions type, their associated operator,
which property they apply, and upon which target.

SyntheticsAssertionBodyHashTarget.description: An assertion which targets body hash.

elementsOperator.description: The element from the list of results to assert on.  To choose from the first element in the list `firstElementMatches`, every element in the list `everyElementMatches`, at least one element in the list `atLeastOneElementMatches` or the serialized value of the list `serializationMatches`.

operator.description: The specific operator to use on the path.

targetValue.description: The path target value to compare to.

SyntheticsAssertionJSONSchemaMetaSchema.description: The JSON Schema meta-schema version used in the assertion.

code.description: The JavaScript code that performs the assertions.

SyntheticsAssertionMCPRespectsSpecificat.description: An assertion that verifies the MCP server response respects the MCP specification.

SyntheticsAssertionMCPServerCapabilities.description: An assertion that checks that an MCP server advertises the expected capabilities.

target.description: List of MCP server capabilities to assert against.

SyntheticsAssertionTarget.description: An assertion which uses a simple target.

SyntheticsAssertionTargetValue.description: Value used by the operator in assertions. Can be either a number or string.

SyntheticsAssertionTargetValueNumber.description: Numeric value used by the operator in assertions.

SyntheticsAssertionTargetValueString.description: String value used by the operator in assertions. Supports templated variables.

SyntheticsAssertionTimingsScope.description: Timings scope for response time assertions.

operator.description: The specific operator to use on the path.

targetValue.description: The path target value to compare to.

SyntheticsBasicAuth.description: Object to handle basic authentication when performing the test.

SyntheticsBasicAuthDigest.description: Object to handle digest authentication when performing the test.

password.description: Password to use for the digest authentication.

username.description: Username to use for the digest authentication.

SyntheticsBasicAuthDigestType.description: The type of basic authentication to use when performing the test.

SyntheticsBasicAuthJWT.description: Object to handle JWT authentication when performing the test.

header.description: Custom JWT header as a JSON string.

payload.description: JWT claims as a JSON string.

secret.description:
Signing key for the JWT authentication. Use the shared secret for `HS256`
or the private key (PEM format) for `RS256` and `ES256`.

tokenPrefix.description: Prefix added before the token in the `Authorization` header. Defaults to `Bearer`.

SyntheticsBasicAuthJWTAddClaims.description: Standard JWT claims to automatically inject.

iat.description: Whether to inject the `iat` (issued at) claim.

SyntheticsBasicAuthJWTAlgorithm.description: Algorithm to use for the JWT authentication.

SyntheticsBasicAuthJWTType.description: The type of authentication to use when performing the test.

SyntheticsBasicAuthNTLM.description: Object to handle `NTLM` authentication when performing the test.

domain.description: Domain for the authentication to use when performing the test.

password.description: Password for the authentication to use when performing the test.

username.description: Username for the authentication to use when performing the test.

workstation.description: Workstation for the authentication to use when performing the test.

SyntheticsBasicAuthNTLMType.description: The type of authentication to use when performing the test.

SyntheticsBasicAuthOauthClient.description: Object to handle `oauth client` authentication when performing the test.

accessTokenUrl.description: Access token URL to use when performing the authentication.

audience.description: Audience to use when performing the authentication.

clientId.description: Client ID to use when performing the authentication.

clientSecret.description: Client secret to use when performing the authentication.

resource.description: Resource to use when performing the authentication.

scope.description: Scope to use when performing the authentication.

SyntheticsBasicAuthOauthClientType.description: The type of basic authentication to use when performing the test.

SyntheticsBasicAuthOauthROP.description: Object to handle `oauth rop` authentication when performing the test.

accessTokenUrl.description: Access token URL to use when performing the authentication.

audience.description: Audience to use when performing the authentication.

clientId.description: Client ID to use when performing the authentication.

clientSecret.description: Client secret to use when performing the authentication.

password.description: Password to use when performing the authentication.

resource.description: Resource to use when performing the authentication.

scope.description: Scope to use when performing the authentication.

username.description: Username to use when performing the authentication.

SyntheticsBasicAuthOauthROPType.description: The type of basic authentication to use when performing the test.

SyntheticsBasicAuthOauthTokenApiAuthenti.description: Type of token to use when performing the authentication.

SyntheticsBasicAuthSigv4.description: Object to handle `SIGV4` authentication when performing the test.

SyntheticsBasicAuthSigv4Type.description: The type of authentication to use when performing the test.

SyntheticsBasicAuthWeb.description: Object to handle basic authentication when performing the test.

password.description: Password to use for the basic authentication.

username.description: Username to use for the basic authentication.

SyntheticsBasicAuthWebType.description: The type of basic authentication to use when performing the test.

SyntheticsBrowserTestRumSettings.description:
The RUM data collection settings for the Synthetic browser test.
**Note:** There are 3 ways to format RUM settings:

`{ isEnabled: false }`
RUM data is not collected.

`{ isEnabled: true }`
RUM data is collected from the Synthetic test's default application.

`{ isEnabled: true, applicationId: "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx", clientTokenId: 12345 }`
RUM data is collected using the specified application.

applicationId.description: RUM application ID used to collect RUM data for the browser test.

clientTokenId.description: RUM application API key ID used to collect RUM data for the browser test.

isEnabled.description: Determines whether RUM data is collected during test runs.

SyntheticsBrowserVariable.description:
Object defining a variable that can be used in your browser test.
See the [Recording Steps documentation](https://docs.datadoghq.com/synthetics/browser_tests/actions/?tab=testanelementontheactivepage#variables).

id.description: ID for the variable. Global variables require an ID.

secure.description: Determines whether or not the browser test variable is obfuscated. Can only be used with browser variables of type `text`.

SyntheticsConfigVariable.description: Object defining a variable that can be used in your test configuration.

id.description: ID of the variable for global variables.

secure.description: Whether the value of this variable will be obfuscated in test results. Only for config variables of type `text`.

SyntheticsMCPProtocolVersion.description: The MCP protocol version used by the step. See https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification.

SyntheticsMCPServerCapability.description: A capability advertised by an MCP server.

SyntheticsRestrictedRoles.description: A list of role identifiers that can be pulled from the Roles API, for restricting read and write access. This field is deprecated. Use the restriction policies API to manage permissions.

SyntheticsStep.description: The steps used in a Synthetic browser test.

allowFailure.description: A boolean set to allow this step to fail.

alwaysExecute.description: A boolean set to always execute this step even if the previous step failed or was skipped.

exitIfSucceed.description: A boolean set to exit the test if the step succeeds.

isCritical.description: A boolean to use in addition to `allowFailure` to determine if the test should be marked as failed when the step fails.

noScreenshot.description: A boolean set to skip taking a screenshot for the step.

public_id.description: The public ID of the step.

timeout.description: The time before declaring a step failed.

SyntheticsStepType.description: Step type used in your Synthetic test.

SyntheticsTestCallType.description:
The type of call to perform. Used by gRPC steps (`healthcheck`, `unary`)
and MCP steps (`init`, `tool_list`, `tool_call`). Valid values depend on
the parent step's `subtype`.

SyntheticsTestCiOptions.description: CI/CD options for a Synthetic test.

SyntheticsTestConfig.description: Configuration object for a Synthetic test.

assertions.description: Array of assertions used for the test. Required for single API tests.

configVariables.description: Array of variables used for the test.

variables.description: Browser tests only - array of variables used for the test steps.

SyntheticsTestDetails.description: Object containing details about your Synthetic test.

locations.description: Array of locations used to run the test.

items.description: A location from which the test was run.

message.description: Notification message associated with the test.

steps.description: The steps of the test if they exist.

tags.description: Array of tags attached to the test.

items.description: A tag attached to the test.

SyntheticsTestDetailsSubType.description:
The subtype of the Synthetic API test, `http`, `ssl`, `tcp`,
`dns`, `icmp`, `udp`, `websocket`, `grpc` or `multi`.

SyntheticsTestExecutionRule.description: Execution rule for a Synthetic test.

SyntheticsTestHeaders.description: Headers to include when performing the test.

SyntheticsTestMetadata.description: Metadata to include when performing the gRPC test.

SyntheticsTestOptions.description: Object describing the extra options for a Synthetic test.

accept_self_signed.description:
For SSL tests, whether or not the test should allow self signed
certificates.

allow_insecure.description: Allows loading insecure content for an HTTP request in an API test.

bits_ai_auto_investigate.description: Whether Bits AI automatically investigates alerts from the test monitor.

blockedRequestPatterns.description: Array of URL patterns to block.

items.description: A URL pattern to block during the Synthetic test.

captureNetworkPayloads.description: Capture HTTP request/response headers and bodies for Fetch/XHR calls made during browser tests.

checkCertificateRevocation.description: For SSL tests, whether or not the test should fail on revoked certificate in stapled OCSP.

device_ids.description: For browser test, array with the different device IDs used to run the test.

disableAiaIntermediateFetching.description: For SSL tests, whether or not the test should disable fetching intermediate certificates from AIA.

disableCors.description: Whether or not to disable CORS mechanism.

disableCsp.description: Disable Content Security Policy for browser tests.

enableSecurityTesting.description: Enable security testing for browser tests. Security testing is not available anymore. This field is deprecated and won't be used.

follow_redirects.description: For API HTTP test, whether or not the test should follow redirects.

ignoreServerCertificateError.description: Ignore server certificate error for browser tests.

ignore_certificate_validation.description: For SSL tests, whether the test should ignore certificate validation.

initialNavigationTimeout.description: Timeout before declaring the initial step as failed (in seconds) for browser tests.

min_failure_duration.description: Minimum amount of time in failure required to trigger an alert.

min_location_failed.description:
Minimum number of locations in failure required to trigger
an alert.

monitor_name.description: The monitor name is used for the alert title as well as for all monitor dashboard widgets and SLOs.

monitor_priority.description: Integer from 1 (high) to 5 (low) indicating alert severity.

noScreenshot.description: Prevents saving screenshots of the steps.

tick_every.description: The frequency at which to run the Synthetic test (in seconds).

SyntheticsTestOptionsHTTPVersion.description: HTTP version to use for a Synthetic test.

SyntheticsTestOptionsMonitorOptions.description:
Object containing the options for a Synthetic test as a monitor
(for example, renotification).

escalation_message.description: Message to include in the escalation notification.

renotify_interval.description:
Time interval before renotifying if the test is still failing
(in minutes).

renotify_occurrences.description: The number of times to renotify if the test is still failing.

SyntheticsTestOptionsMonitorOptionsNotif.description: The name of the preset for the notification for the monitor.

SyntheticsTestOptionsRetry.description: Object describing the retry strategy to apply to a Synthetic test.

count.description:
Number of times a test needs to be retried before marking a
location as failed. Defaults to 0.

interval.description:
Time interval between retries (in milliseconds). Defaults to
300ms.

SyntheticsTestOptionsScheduling.description: Object containing timeframes and timezone used for advanced scheduling.

timeframes.description: Array containing objects describing the scheduling pattern to apply to each day.

timezone.description: Timezone in which the timeframe is based.

day.description: Number representing the day of the week.

from.description: The hour of the day on which scheduling starts.

to.description: The hour of the day on which scheduling ends.

SyntheticsTestPauseStatus.description:
Define whether you want to start (`live`) or pause (`paused`) a
Synthetic test.

SyntheticsTestRequest.description: Object describing the Synthetic test request.

allow_insecure.description: Allows loading insecure content for an HTTP request in a multistep test step.

body.description: Body to include in the test.

certificateDomains.description: By default, the client certificate is applied on the domain of the starting URL for browser tests. If you want your client certificate to be applied on other domains instead, add them in `certificateDomains`.

items.description: Domain to apply the client certificate.

compressedJsonDescriptor.description: A protobuf JSON descriptor that needs to be gzipped first then base64 encoded.

compressedProtoFile.description: A protobuf file that needs to be gzipped first then base64 encoded.

disableAiaIntermediateFetching.description: Disable fetching intermediate certificates from AIA.

dnsServer.description: DNS server to use for DNS tests.

dnsServerPort.description: DNS server port to use for DNS tests.

files.description: Files to be used as part of the request in the test. Only valid if `bodyType` is `multipart/form-data`.

follow_redirects.description: Specifies whether or not the request follows redirects.

form.description: Form to be used as part of the request in the test. Only valid if `bodyType` is `multipart/form-data`.

host.description: Host name to perform the test with.

ignore_certificate_validation.description: For SSL tests, whether the test should ignore certificate validation.

isMessageBase64Encoded.description: Whether the message is base64 encoded.

message.description: Message to send for UDP or WebSocket tests.

method.description: Either the HTTP method/verb to use or a gRPC method available on the service set in the `service` field. Required if `subtype` is `HTTP` or if `subtype` is `grpc` and `callType` is `unary`.

noSavingResponseBody.description: Determines whether or not to save the response body.

numberOfPackets.description: Number of pings to use per test.

query.description: Query to use for the test.

servername.description:
For SSL tests, it specifies on which server you want to initiate the TLS handshake,
allowing the server to present one of multiple possible certificates on
the same IP address and TCP port number.

service.description: The gRPC service on which you want to perform the gRPC call.

shouldTrackHops.description: Turns on a traceroute probe to discover all gateways along the path to the host destination.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the test.

toolArgs.description: Arguments to pass to the MCP tool. Free-form object whose shape depends on the tool. Used when `callType` is `tool_call`.

toolName.description: The name of the MCP tool to call. Required when `callType` is `tool_call`.

url.description: URL to perform the test with.

SyntheticsTestRequestBodyFile.description: Object describing a file to be used as part of the request in the test.

encoding.description: Encoding of the file content. The only supported value is `base64`, indicating the `content` field contains base64-encoded data.

SyntheticsTestRequestCertificate.description: Client certificate to use when performing the test request.

content.description: Content of the certificate or key.

filename.description: File name for the certificate or key.

updatedAt.description: Date of update of the certificate or key, ISO format.

SyntheticsTestRequestDNSServerPort.description: DNS server port to use for DNS tests.

SyntheticsTestRequestNumericalDNSServerP.description: Integer DNS server port number to use when performing the test.

SyntheticsTestRequestNumericalPort.description: Integer Port number to use when performing the test.

SyntheticsTestRequestPort.description: Port to use when performing the test.

SyntheticsTestRequestProxy.description: The proxy to perform the test.

url.description: URL of the proxy to perform the test.

SyntheticsTestRequestVariableDNSServerPo.description: String DNS server port number to use when performing the test. Supports templated variables.

SyntheticsTestRequestVariablePort.description: String Port number to use when performing the test. Supports templated variables.
